physicalNotes: Radius: the limb-darkened angular diameter 6.039 +/- 0.019 mas that Kervella et al. (2003, A&A 408, 681) measure on Sirius A with VLTI/VINCI, at the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 379.21 +/- 1.58 mas (2.6371 pc): 1,191,189 km, 1.712 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius (the paper gives 1.711 +/- 0.013). No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: no rotation axis is measured, so the presentation frame puts the display axis (celestial north at the star) up.
